name: Caesar's Empire

categories.label: Road points
categories.help: Points collected on the score track during play for roads on routes back to Rome, including any doubled by gold.

categories.label: City tokens
categories.help: Add the value of your highest city token in each colour; lower tokens of a colour score nothing (all tokens of a colour add up if you use the optional 2-3 player rule).

categories.label: Sets of different treasures
categories.help: Points for each set of different treasures, as read from the score table on your board (gold does not count).

categories.label: Sets of the same treasure
categories.help: Points for each column of identical treasures, as read from the score table on your board (gold does not count).

categories.label: Gold
categories.help: Points shown under the furthest gold token on your gold track.

categories.label: Most roads left
categories.help: Tick if you have the most roads still unplaced; tied players all tick it (10 points).

categories.label: City colours
categories.help: Number of different city colours you hold; the most wins a tie.

categories.label: Gold tokens
categories.help: Number of gold tokens you collected; the most wins a tie after colours.

categories.label: Roads left
categories.help: Roads still unplaced in front of you; the most wins a tie after gold.

source.rulebook_title: Cäsars Imperium Regel (German edition of the Caesar's Empire rulebook)
source.edition_or_year: Holy Grail Games, 2022; German edition by Asmodee Germany

notes: Base game only. Read the publisher-hosted German edition from Asmodee Germany and cross-checked the English rulebook text as uploaded on Scribd (a third-party copy, not publisher-hosted). Both give the same scoring and tie-breakers. The rulebook states no further tie rule after the third tie-breaker. The 2-3 player variants are not modelled beyond the city-colour note. Player count 2-5 is from the rulebook board sides (2/3 and 4/5).
